source: Original Half-Life owner handoff, 2026-09-22. Visual acceptance and campaign validation are identified separately. No support claimed for other editions.

items.label: Entity ESP
items.desc: Display supported received entities in the original Half-Life local game.

items.label: Boxes
items.desc: Full or corner boxes with configurable appearance.

items.label: Entity names
items.desc: Labels for supported stock models; NPC health and faction are not inferred.

items.label: Distance
items.desc: Distances displayed in metres.

items.label: Skeletons
items.desc: Animated bones for supported rendered studio models.

items.label: Snaplines
items.desc: Connect supported entities to the selected screen anchor.

items.label: Radar
items.desc: A configurable overview of supported entity positions.

items.label: Entity categories
items.desc: Filter players, NPCs, weapons, items and projectiles.

items.label: Interactables
items.desc: Optional doors, buttons, chargers, breakables and lifts from supported BSP data.

items.label: Material styles
items.desc: Tinted, Flat, Wireframe and Additive OpenGL passes.

items.label: Visible and occluded colors
items.desc: Independent model colors for visible and hidden passes.

items.label: Animated chams
items.desc: Pulse, Color fade and Rainbow, with speed and strength controls.

items.label: First-person weapon
items.desc: Optional material treatment for the first-person weapon.

items.label: Color grading
items.desc: A configurable whole-frame tint, including the stock HUD.

items.label: Saved profiles
items.desc: Save and restore menu preferences in scoped profiles.

items.label: Feature hotkeys
items.desc: Bind frequently used controls through the shared menu.

items.label: Appearance
items.desc: Customize menu colors, fonts and scale.

items.label: Language packs
items.desc: Shared UI translations with English fallback; product-specific translations are incomplete.

items.label: Lua pages
items.desc: Local sandboxed UI and configuration scripting.

items.label: Session and entity API
items.desc: Read copied supported Half-Life session and entity information without engine pointers.

items.label: Stop
items.desc: Stop active features and restore owned input routing; restart the game to replace the DLL.

items.label: Godmode
items.desc: Verified for the original Windows local campaign. Prevent player damage and restore normal behavior on disable.

items.label: Noclip
items.desc: Verified for the original Windows local campaign. Local campaign movement with state restoration.

items.label: Infinite ammo
items.desc: Verified for the original Windows local campaign. Reserve ammunition controls for supported weapons.

items.label: No reload
items.desc: Verified for the original Windows local campaign. Magazine refill; melee and clipless weapons are handled separately.

items.label: Super run
items.desc: Verified for the original Windows local campaign. Adjustable local campaign movement speed.

items.label: Jump controls
items.desc: Verified for the original Windows local campaign. Campaign jump multiplier.

items.label: Health and armor
items.desc: Verified for the original Windows local campaign. Restore the local campaign playerâ€™s health and armor.

items.label: Spawners
items.desc: Verified for the original Windows local campaign. Supported items, weapons and NPCs with bounded placement and cleanup.
